export async function invalidateCache(event: ChangeEvent): Promise<void> {
  const keys = await resolveKeys(event.table, event.primaryKey)
  for (const key of keys) {
    await redis.del(key)
    metrics.increment("cache.invalidation", { table: event.table })
  }
  logger.info(`evicted ${keys.length} keys for ${event.table}`)
}

export function subscribe(stream: ChangeStream): void {
  stream.on("change", (event) => void invalidateCache(event))
  stream.on("error", (err) => logger.error("change stream failed", err))
}
